answer.worked:
The ordinate of $f$ is the vertical gap between the supplied curve and $y=x$.
$$\begin{align*}f(0)&=1-0=1\\f\left(\frac14\right)&=\frac34-\frac14=\frac12.\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,1)$ and $(\tfrac14,\tfrac12)$. The displayed vertical gap remains positive and decreases as $x$ increases, tending to zero. Sketch a decreasing curve through these points approaching the $x$-axis from above.

spec.description: Recovered positive decreasing curve with y-intercept 1 and a black marked point (1/4,1/2), approaching the x-axis to the right.
spec.mathematics: Subtract x from the supplied ordinate. f(0)=1 and f(1/4)=1/2. The curve is schematic because neither source nor answer evidence supplies an analytic formula.
